column8: List (String × ℤ) → Prop := fun xs => ∀ p ∈ xs, p.1.toList.head? ≠ Option.some 'j'

∀ (stem : String) (c : Char), stem.toList.head? = Option.some c → c ≠ 'j' → ∀ (offset : ℕ) (bytes : List UInt8), Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceController.JointSlots.Unjoint (Minidregg.Compiler.ResourceAuthorityProjection.bytesSlots stem offset bytes)

∀ (before after : Minidregg.Kernel.ContentResource.ContentStore) (command : Minidregg.Kernel.ContentResource.Command), Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceController.JointSlots.Unjoint (Minidregg.Kernel.ContentResource.project before after command)
∀ (k : String) (xs ys : List (String × ℤ)), { slots := xs ++ ys }.get k = ({ slots := xs }.get k).or ({ slots := ys }.get k)

∀ (K : ℕ → String → String), (∀ (m n : ℕ) (s t : String), K m s = K n t → m = n ∧ s = t) → ∀ (m n : ℕ) (slot : String) (xs : List (String × ℤ)), { slots := List.map (fun p => (K m p.1, p.2)) xs }.get (K n slot) = if m = n then { slots := xs }.get slot else Option.none

∀ {α : Type} (K : ℕ → String → String), (∀ (m n : ℕ) (s t : String), K m s = K n t → m = n ∧ s = t) → ∀ (f : α → ℕ) (S : α → List (String × ℤ)) (slot : String) (L : List α), (List.map f L).Nodup → ∀ j ∈ L, { slots := List.flatMap (fun j => List.map (fun p => (K (f j) p.1, p.2)) (S j)) L }.get (K (f j) slot) = { slots := S j }.get slot

∀ {α : Type} (K : ℕ → String → String), (∀ (m n : ℕ) (s t : String), K m s = K n t → m = n ∧ s = t) → ∀ (f : α → ℕ) (S : α → List (String × ℤ)) (n : ℕ) (slot : String) (L : List α), (∀ j ∈ L, f j ≠ n) → { slots := List.flatMap (fun j => List.map (fun p => (K (f j) p.1, p.2)) (S j)) L }.get (K n slot) = Option.none
∀ (k : String) (xs : List (String × ℤ)), (∀ p ∈ xs, p.1 ≠ k) → { slots := xs }.get k = Option.none
∀ (xs : List (String × ℤ)), Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceController.JointSlots.Unjoint xs → ∀ (k : String), k.toList.head? = Option.some 'j' → { slots := xs }.get k = Option.none
∀ (stem rest : String) (c : Char), stem.toList.head? = Option.some c → (stem ++ rest).toList.head? = Option.some c
∀ (m : ℕ) (s : String), (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceController.jointIndexKey m s).toList.head? = Option.some 'j'
∀ (m n : ℕ) (s t : String), Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceController.jointIndexKey m s = Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceController.jointIndexKey n t → m = n ∧ s = t

∀ (targets : List Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceController.Target) (slots : Fin targets.length → List (String × ℤ)) (i : Fin targets.length) (slot : String), { slots := Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceController.jointSlots targets slots }.get (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceController.jointIndexKey (↑i) slot) = { slots := slots i }.get slot

∀ (targets : List Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceController.Target) (slots : Fin targets.length → List (String × ℤ)) (n : ℕ), targets.length ≤ n → ∀ (slot : String), { slots := Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceController.jointSlots targets slots }.get (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceController.jointIndexKey n slot) = Option.none

∀ (targets : List Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceController.Target) (slots : Fin targets.length → List (String × ℤ)), (List.map Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceController.Target.target targets).Nodup → ∀ (i : Fin targets.length) (slot : String), { slots := Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceController.jointSlots targets slots }.get (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceController.jointTargetKey targets[i].target slot) = { slots := slots i }.get slot
∀ (m : ℕ) (s : String), (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceController.jointTargetKey m s).toList.head? = Option.some 'j'
∀ (m n : ℕ) (s t : String), Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceController.jointTargetKey m s = Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceController.jointTargetKey n t → m = n ∧ s = t
∀ (m n : ℕ) (s t : String), Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceController.jointTargetKey m s ≠ Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceController.jointIndexKey n t
∀ (stem : String) (m n : ℕ) (s t : String), stem ++ ToString.toString m ++ "/" ++ s = stem ++ ToString.toString n ++ "/" ++ t → m = n ∧ s = t
